title.en: Almost-Isometric Embeddings of Graphs into Riemannian Manifolds
title.zh: 图到黎曼流形的近等距嵌入

summary.en: We construct noncontractive $(1+\varepsilon)$-embeddings of finite connected positively weighted graph metrics into smooth closed orientable surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^3$, for arbitrarily small $\varepsilon>0$. This construction transfers coding advantages from graphs to surfaces. We establish unbounded coding advantage across smooth closed surfaces, together with an $O(\log(g+2))$ upper bound in terms of genus $g$ for both graphs and surfaces.
summary.zh: 我们将任意有限连通正权图的度量，以不收缩的 $(1+\varepsilon)$ 失真嵌入 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中的光滑闭可定向曲面，其中 $\varepsilon>0$ 可任意小。这一构造将图上的编码优势转移到曲面上，并给出编码优势可任意大的光滑闭曲面，以及图和曲面上关于亏格 $g$ 的 $O(\log(g+2))$ 编码优势上界。

title.en: When Multiple-Unicast Feasibility Is Equivalent to Single-Sink Routability
title.zh: 多单播可行性何时等价于单汇可路由性

summary.en: We show that when the maximum flow between every pair of distinct destinations is at least the total demand rate, multiple-unicast coding and fractional routing are equivalent in feasibility to routing all source rates to any fixed destination. This yields a maximum-flow algorithm for deciding feasibility and proves the Langberg–Médard conjecture as a corollary.
summary.zh: 我们证明，若任意两个不同目的节点之间的最大流不小于总需求速率，则多单播编码、分数路由与将所有源速率同时路由至任一固定目的节点在可行性上等价。由此得到基于最大流的可行性判定算法，并将 Langberg–Médard 猜想作为推论证明。

title.en: Undirected Multiple-Unicast Network Coding and Faster External-Memory Integer Sorting
title.zh: 无向多单播网络编码与更快的外存整数排序

summary.en: We study the advantage of network coding over fractional routing in undirected networks and use the construction to develop faster external-memory integer sorting algorithms.
summary.zh: 我们研究网络编码相对于分数路由在无向网络中的优势，并利用这一构造设计更快的外存整数排序算法。

title.en: On the Multiple-Unicast Conjecture: Beyond Cut Metrics
title.zh: 多单播猜想：超越割度量

publications.authors: **Sirui Liu**, Li Que, Zongpeng Li, Baochun Li

summary.en: We develop a unified metric framework for comparing network coding and routing, proving their equivalence for new classes of undirected networks.
summary.zh: 我们建立了比较网络编码与路由的统一度量框架，并在若干新的无向网络类别中证明二者等价。

title.en: A Session Interaction Framework for The Multiple-Unicast Conjecture
title.zh: 多单播猜想的会话交互框架

publications.authors: **Sirui Liu**, Zongpeng Li, Xiying Fan, Haifeng Chen

summary.en: We develop a **Session Interaction Framework** that combines session dominance and session decoupling to reduce the analysis of network coding and routing to irreducible cores and independent subsets.
summary.zh: 我们提出**会话交互框架**，结合会话支配与会话解耦，将网络编码与路由的分析归约到不可约核心和独立子集。

title.en: On the Multiple-Unicast Conjecture: Session Dominance

publications.authors: **Sirui Liu**, Yeqiao Hou, Jessie Hui Wang, Zongpeng Li

summary.en: We introduce a **session dominance** framework: if the conjecture holds for a particular set of sessions, it also holds for another, dominated set.
summary.zh: 我们提出**会话支配框架**：若猜想对某一组会话成立，那么对被其支配的另一组会话也成立。

title.en: Space Information Flow: Multiple Unicast in $l_p^n$
title.zh: 空间信息流：$l_p^n$ 空间中的多单播

summary.en: We show that network coding is equivalent to routing in $l_p^n$ spaces for $1 \leq p \leq 2$.
summary.zh: 我们证明，当 $1 \leq p \leq 2$ 时，网络编码与路由在 $l_p^n$ 空间中等价。

title.en: FitFEC: A Multi-Scale Transformer for Optimizing Packet Loss Recovery
title.zh: FitFEC：用于优化丢包恢复的多尺度 Transformer

publications.authors: Yining Li, **Sirui Liu**, Zongpeng Li, Liang Du, Ling Deng

en.name: Sirui Liu
biography: I am currently a Ph.D. candidate at the Institute for Network Sciences and Cyberspace, Tsinghua University, advised by Professor Zongpeng Li. I received my bachelor’s degree from the School of Software, Tsinghua University.

My main research area is network coding. My broader research interests include combinatorial optimization, metric geometry, algorithms, and computational complexity, particularly their connections to network coding.

overviewParagraphs: My research studies the coding advantage of network coding over fractional routing in undirected multiple-unicast networks. To characterize regimes with no coding advantage, I work along two directions. In discrete topology, I use demand reductions and metrics beyond cut metrics to identify graph and demand structures where routing achieves the same rates as coding; under pairwise destination max-flow conditions, I further show that multiple-unicast feasibility coincides with single-sink routability, yielding a maximum-flow feasibility algorithm and a proof of the Langberg–Médard conjecture. In continuous geometry, I study space information flow and show that coding offers no advantage over routing in $\ell_p^n$ spaces for $1 \le p \le 2$. Where coding does outperform routing, I construct almost-isometric embeddings of graphs into smooth closed surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^3$ to transfer coding advantages from graphs to surfaces, establishing unbounded coding advantage across surfaces alongside an $O(\log(g+2))$ upper bound on the coding advantage in terms of genus $g$ for both graphs and surfaces. Finally, I turn coding advantages into algorithmic speedups, such as reducing block transfers in external-memory integer sorting.

overviewParagraphs: 我的研究关注无向多单播网络中网络编码相对于分数路由的编码优势。为刻画不存在编码优势的情形，我从两个方向展开研究。在离散拓扑方面，我利用需求归约和超越割度量的工具，识别路由能够达到与编码相同速率的图结构和需求结构；在目的节点两两之间满足最大流条件时，我进一步证明多单播可行性等价于单汇可路由性，由此得到基于最大流的可行性判定算法，并证明 Langberg–Médard 猜想。在连续几何方面，我研究空间信息流，并证明在 $1 \le p \le 2$ 的 $\ell_p^n$ 空间中，编码相对于路由没有优势。在编码确实优于路由的情形下，我构造图到 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中光滑闭曲面的近等距嵌入，将编码优势从图推广至曲面，证明曲面上的编码优势可以无界，同时给出图和曲面上编码优势关于亏格 $g$ 的 $O(\log(g+2))$ 上界。最后，我将编码优势转化为算法加速，例如减少外存整数排序中的块传输次数。
